thesis.core: 2026H1 revenue and normalized earnings accelerated as overseas curtain-wall revenue and higher-margin international mix expanded, with RMB38.23bn remaining construction obligations providing visibility; however, current valuation is near the top of its own history, cash conversion remains negative, and a planned 3% shareholder reduction adds a near-term overhang.
thesis.variant_wedge: The overseas inflection is real and the RMB840.82m Shouyi Medical related-party repurchase improves liquidity, but neither justifies treating the current rerating as low-risk because total H1 new orders declined, interior-decoration orders weakened, and construction working-capital intensity remains material.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026E normalized EPS bear/base/bull of RMB0.62/RMB0.76/RMB0.90, anchored to H1 EPS RMB0.39 and deduct profit RMB448.45m, consensus near RMB0.75 EPS, overseas margin expansion, and exclusion of one-off disposal/repurchase gains.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Earnings quality improved, but operating cash flow is still negative and construction receivable/contract-asset exposure remains a material valuation constraint.

capital_and_event_update.repurchase_effect: Liquidity positive and potential one-off P&L uplift; excluded from normalized EPS.
capital_and_event_update.shareholder_sell_down: A 13.78% shareholder plans to reduce up to 3.0% of total shares between 2026-10-15 and 2027-01-14.
capital_and_event_update.award_note: Saudi Northwest Transportation Hub curtain-wall award; contract execution remained subject to formal signing at announcement.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Base tracks H1 run-rate and current consensus while excluding one-off Shouyi repurchase gains.

catalysts: Overseas backlog converts to revenue while overseas gross margin remains structurally above mainland levels.
RMB840.82m Shouyi Medical repurchase consideration is collected on schedule and improves liquidity without new related-party leakage.
New-order growth re-accelerates, especially interior decoration and Middle East/Asia curtain-wall awards.
Operating cash flow improves materially as receivables and contract assets convert.
kill_thesis: Overseas project execution, FX, claims or collection issues erode the current margin advantage.
New orders and backlog conversion weaken enough to break the 2026-2027 earnings growth path.
Operating cash flow remains structurally negative while receivables/contract assets continue to expand.
The related-party repurchase is delayed, impaired, or replaced by value-destructive capital allocation.
Valuation remains above a high-teens normalized PE without a matching earnings upgrade.
